mechanism: An automated binding mechanism where an {{actor}} cryptographically commits to a {{rule_set}}. This creates a self-enforcing constraint where deviation triggers an automatic penalty (defined in the rules) via {{spot_audit}}.
invariants: Penalty execution requires cryptographic evidence of the deviation.
Immutability: rules cannot be changed after signing.

_meta.caution: Automated penalties — misconfigured rules cause cascading harm.

failure_modes: Penalty severity decoupled from deviation severity.
No path to contest: evidence is sound and the rule it proves a breach of was misconfigured, so an automated penalty executes correctly and wrongly.
